title: Leukemia Risk Factor ARID5B Coordinates HDAC-Mediated Transcriptional Repression
authors: Kutschat AP; Frommelt F; Santini BL; Muller S; Batty P; Karbon G; Superti-Furga G; Seruggia D
one_liner_zh: 该文通过蛋白质组学、基因组学和转录组学表征ARID5B与HDAC形成染色质抑制复合物并调控B细胞基因，虽涉及蛋白-DNA结合（CUT&RUN）但无AI/物理模拟方法，且非TF-DNA特异性结合建模，与本课题方法轴不匹配。
abstract: Multiple genetic association studies linked variants at ARID5B with predisposition to B-cell derived acute lymphoblastic leukemia (B-ALL) in children. Still, the molecular function of ARID5B remains largely uncharacterized. Here, we employ a combination of proteomics, genomics and transcriptomics to describe the molecular mechanisms of ARID5B. We identify that ARID5B interacts with MIER1, C16ORF87, HDAC1 and HDAC2 forming a chromatin repressor complex. By CUT&RUN, we mapped ARID5B binding in active regions of the genome, tethering HDAC1 and HDAC2 to distal regulatory elements and promoters. Genes actively repressed by the ARID5B repressor complex are involved in B cell proliferation and B cell-specific signaling. Together, we describe how ARID5B assembles into a repressor complex and regulates B cell-specific processes. Understanding its molecular mechanism will help elucidating how non-coding germline variants at ARID5B predispose to B-ALL.
abstract_zh: 多项遗传关联研究将ARID5B的变异与儿童B细胞来源的急性淋巴细胞白血病（B-ALL）的易感性联系起来。然而，ARID5B的分子功能在很大程度上仍未明确。在此，我们结合蛋白质组学、基因组学和转录组学来描述ARID5B的分子机制。我们发现ARID5B与MIER1、C16ORF87、HDAC1和HDAC2相互作用，形成一种染色质抑制复合物。通过CUT&RUN技术，我们绘制了ARID5B在基因组活性区域的结合图谱，将其锚定到远端调控元件和启动子上，并招募HDAC1和HDAC2。由ARID5B抑制复合物主动抑制的基因涉及B细胞增殖和B细胞特异性信号传导。综合来看，我们描述了ARID5B如何组装成抑制复合物并调控B细胞特异性过程。理解其分子机制将有助于阐明ARID5B处的非编码种系变异如何导致B-ALL的易感性。
